<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"Takes a backup of history data"}
></Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/backupHistory"}
  context={"endpoint"}
></MethodEndpoint>

Start taking a backup with the given backupId. Takes one backup per physical tenant unless
`physicalTenant` narrows the operation to one.

<Heading id={"request"} as={"h2"} className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}>
  <Translate id="theme.openapi.request.title">Request</Translate>
</Heading>

<ParamsDetails
  parameters={[
    {
      name: "physicalTenant",
      required: false,
      in: "query",
      description:
        "Narrows the operation to the given physical tenant. When omitted, the operation covers every\nphysical tenant of the cluster, which on a single-tenant cluster is the one `default` tenant\nand therefore unchanged behavior.\n",
      schema: {
        title: "Physical Tenant ID",
        description:
          "The id of a physical tenant, as configured under `camunda.physical-tenants`. A cluster that\nconfigures none has exactly one physical tenant, `default`.\n",
        type: "string",
        example: "tenanta",
      },
    },
  ]}
></ParamsDetails>

<RequestSchema
  title={"Body"}
  body={{
    required: true,
    content: {
      "application/json": {
        schema: {
          title: "TakeBackupRequest",
          description: "Request body for take backup",
          type: "object",
          required: ["backupId"],
          properties: {
            backupId: {
              description: "The ID of the backup to be taken",
              allOf: [
                {
                  title: "Backup ID",
                  description:
                    "The ID of the backup. The ID of the backup must be a positive numerical value. As backups\nare logically ordered by their IDs (ascending), each successive backup must use a higher\nID than the previous one.\n",
                  type: "integer",
                  format: "int64",
                  example: 1,
                  minimum: 0,
                },
              ],
            },
          },
        },
      },
    },
  }}
></RequestSchema>

      description: "A backup has been successfully scheduled",
      content: {
        "application/json": {
          schema: {
            title: "TakeBackupResponse",
            description: "Request body for take backup",
            type: "object",
            properties: {
              scheduledSnapshots: {
                type: "array",
                items: {
                  type: "string",
                  description:
                    "Snapshot identifier following the pattern camunda_operate_[id]_[version]_part_[current]_of_[total]",

                },
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
    },
